purpose: 读法 A 的变体 A'：每层能量不变，闪热时长取真实光斑扫过一个 200 um 单元的驻留时间 (0.2 mm / 650 mm/s = 3.08e-4 s) 而不是整层扫描时间 1.2363 s，其余扫描时间作为关灯保温子步。动机：读法 A 在生产网格上实测峰温只有 595 K，没有任何单元越过 T_cut、也不屈服（2-slab shakedown eqp = 0），而 Balbaa 的点源在 200 um 单元上每次经过就给该单元 ~700 K 的升温。A' 恢复了单元尺度的峰值，但整层同时升温、无面内次序。

geometry.substrate_footprint_note: substrate_xy_m 0.03 is the D-V2-07 figure-derived value; the MODELLED footprint is 0.02 m (2 x cube width) because the 30 mm variant (305k cells, 1.0 M mechanics DOF) builds on the RTX 5080 (GPU peak 12.3 GB, host RSS 39.8 GB at the 40 GB WSL cap) but the substrate-release solve, which instantiates a second problem, runs the 16 GB GPU out of memory (memory probes 3 and 4, 2026-08-27, with and without the XLA cache). The 20 mm variant (205k cells, 0.67 M DOF) passes build + release: GPU peak 9.5 GB, host RSS 37.7 GB, 150 s per full-size mechanics solve. Registered as a D-V2-07 production amendment; footprint sensitivity 20 vs 30 mm is to be measured on a reduced-height build (no release needed for that comparison).

layer_schedule.activation_rule: activate a 200 um slab when its first contained 40 um physical-layer flash starts

flash.note: legacy Gaussian exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) with r = 100 mm centred on the 10 mm footprint: centre-to-corner drop 1.0 %, captured fraction erf(sqrt2 a/r)^2 = 0.00635. The commanded power 140/0.00635 = 22,047 W is an aggregation construct (the AM-Bench L0 rev-4 argument: the conserved invariants are the per-layer energy 173.08 J and the layer clock 1.2363 s); the ledger measures the deposited energy against Ac x 173.08 J per layer. Rotation/hatch have no meaning for a flash and are kept only to define the real scan time. Balbaa's own cube result: hatch spacing does not affect the in-depth RS profile (Sec 4.3.2). VARIANT A': duration_s = cell dwell time 3.08e-4 s in 2 sub-steps, then 10 geometric laser-off hold sub-steps spanning the remaining 1.236 s of the real scan time; commanded power scales by t_scan/t_flash on top of 1/capture.

thermal_mechanical.release_rule: substrate cells cut (stiffness and locked-in stress removed) + 3-point rigid-body anchors on printed nodes; bottom Dirichlet temperature held at the preheat value through cooldown (Balbaa: 600 s cooling, then model-change removal of the substrate)

runner.heat_source_note: depth band identical to the smoke contract (vertex-collocated lumped source, discrete band integral = 1, see cube-stress-smoke.json); the in-plane radius is overridden by scan.flash.beam_radius_m in flash mode.

consolidation.note: as in the smoke contract: melt detection off (sentinel), T_ref 1273.15 K once at activation, T_cut lifecycle events force mechanics solves (no deferral switch yet).

mechanics.note: 22 rows per physical layer (2 flash + 10 hold + 10 recoat sub-steps); T_cut events add forced solves where the flash peak crosses 1273 K.

linear_solver.note: GPU assembly + CPU MKL PARDISO (solver-compare/results/RESULTS.md). The wrapper default assembly chunk (262,144 cells) cut the 305k-cell mesh into 2 chunks of 152,500 cells and the mechanics tangent kernel_jac (f64[152500,24,8,3,3] = 2.1 GB per array) ran the RTX 5080 out of its 16 GB (memory probe 2026-08-27, peak 12.5 GB then CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY; host RSS 10.7 GB). cell_target_batch_size 32768 keeps each chunk's tangent arrays ~0.45 GB. Memory feasibility at ~1.0 M mechanics DOF is checked by model/runs/v_cube_memory_probe.sh before any production run.
